rule: A SUBSET S OF SIZE TWO BREAKS A DEPENDENCY, ON A GIVEN PRIMITIVE, IF AND ONLY IF SOME X IN S IS DETERMINED BY AT LEAST ONE DERIVED EDGE AND EVERY COMPONENT THAT DETERMINES X BY A DERIVED EDGE IS ALSO IN S -- so the information deleting X alone leaves recoverable is no longer recoverable once S is deleted. A subset containing a component with no determiner at all does not thereby break a dependency: deleting that component already removed information at depth 1.
what_this_does_not_buy: IT DOES NOT MEASURE THE NON-BREAKING SUBSETS AND A NON-BREAKING SUBSET IS NOT THEREBY SAFE.
